config.moduleName: Settle - Seat Collision for SMP Cloth

group.name: Which Faster HDT-SMP variant did you install?

plugin.name: AVX
plugin.description: Pick the same variant you chose when installing Faster HDT-SMP. AVX runs on every CPU from roughly 2011 on.

plugin.name: AVX2
plugin.description: Pick the same variant you chose when installing Faster HDT-SMP. AVX2: most CPUs from roughly 2013 (Intel) / 2015 (AMD) on.

plugin.name: AVX-512
plugin.description: Pick the same variant you chose when installing Faster HDT-SMP. AVX-512 only runs on CPUs that support it (many Intel desktop CPUs do not); if unsure, choose AVX2.

plugin.name: Main (recommended)
plugin.description:
Seat collision for SMP cloth (cloth rests on chairs, benches and stools instead of passing through them) PLUS the seated hug: while seated, the lower cloth of short skirts and robes is tied to the legs so it lies on the lap. Long skirts automatically keep normal physics + seat collision. Works for the player and NPCs. Riding: skirts drape over the horse instead of flattening into a disc, and short skirts are tied to the thighs.
Requires Faster HDT-SMP 4.1.1 installed; Settle must overwrite its hdtsmp64.dll (place Settle below / after FSMP).

plugin.name: Collision Only
plugin.description:
Only the seat collision: cloth rests on seats instead of passing through them, but is otherwise simulated normally (no seated hug, no seat swap, no riding hug). The riding fixes (ground plane off, horse collider) are included. The hugs can be turned on later in SKSE\Plugins\Settle.ini (bAutoHug = 1, bSeatSwap = 1, bRidingHug = 1).
Requires Faster HDT-SMP 4.1.1 installed; Settle must overwrite its hdtsmp64.dll (place Settle below / after FSMP).
